risk_note: Guard change (tightening only; D10-2219 / D10-2223 / D10-2270 / D10-2278 / D10-2282; ledger patch 1 #423). New static check tools/guard/ledger-writers.ts, wired into guard static (run.ts): any tracked .ts / .sql file outside the allowlist that writes app.ledger_entries, app.ledger_vouchers or app.account_balances (Kysely insertInto / updateTable / deleteFrom / mergeInto / replaceInto with a literal table; INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / MERGE / TRUNCATE (every table of the list) / COPY ... FROM in .sql files and in SQL inside .ts strings and templates, schema prefix, quoted identifiers, across lines, with comments blanked first; single-quoted SQL literals are data except the one right after EXECUTE; dollar-quoted bodies are scanned) fails with file:line, the table and what to do. Allowlist tools/guard/ledger-writers.allow.txt, one path per line with a reason, no wildcards, a missing path is a problem: apps/api/src/modules/ledger/infra/store.ts (the only write point; B2-02x's recalc writes through it), the merged migration 0054, three files whose strings only hold SQL text (two apps unit tests asserting emitted SQL, tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts) and 21 test/spec fixture directories. Allowed by file, not by module: a new file under modules/ledger that writes is refused. In git mode only tracked files are scanned. tools/guard/guard-cli.test.ts: the two cases that pin the guard static output gain one PASS line (6 -> 7 passed), nothing else. Scope and known limits (dynamic SQL, table names assembled at run time, Unicode-escaped identifiers, views / aliases, writes inside database functions, psql inline COPY data) are in the guard's header comment and FU-LEDGER-WRITERS-LEXER-LIMITS. Merge needs the owner label (approvals 16).
